title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Oil price slides as US and Iran pause fire; cancer treatments help AstraZeneca beat profit forecasts – business live
title.zh: 美国和伊朗暂停交火，油价下跌；癌症治疗帮助阿斯利康超出利润预期——商业直播

summary.en: Oil prices declined following a pause in hostilities between the US and Iran. Meanwhile, AstraZeneca exceeded profit forecasts, partly due to successful cancer treatments, and European airline shares also saw strong gains.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗暂停交火后，油价下跌。与此同时，阿斯利康公司因成功的癌症治疗而超出利润预期，欧洲航空公司的股价也强劲上涨。

body.en: Rolling coverage of the latest economic and financial news Shares in European airlines are also rising strongly this morning – Ryanair is up 2.6%, while British Airways owner International Consolidated Airlines Group is up about 3%. Budget airline Wizz Air is also up by 3.2%. US stocks are poised to join the global market rally later this afternoon – futures for the blue chip S&P 500 index are pointing to a 0.9% rise, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq is poised to rise 1.5%. US airlines are also set to rise, with Delta and American up 2.6% and 3% in pre-market trading. Cruise operators Royal Caribbean and Carnival are also up by about 3% each. Continue reading...
body.zh: 最新经济和金融新闻的滚动报道 今天上午，欧洲航空公司的股价也强劲上涨——瑞安航空 (Ryanair) 上涨 2.6%，而英国航空公司 (British Airways) 的所有者国际联合航空集团 (International Consolidated Airlines Group) 则上涨约 3%。廉价航空公司 Wizz Air 的股价也上涨了 3.2%。美国股市将于今天下午晚些时候加入全球市场的涨势——蓝筹股标准普尔 500 指数期货预计上涨 0.9%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数预计上涨 1.5%。美国航空公司也将上涨，达美航空和美国航空在盘前交易中分别上涨 2.6% 和 3%。游轮运营商皇家加勒比和嘉年华也分别上涨约 3%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a pause in hostilities between nations, however temporary, reminds us of the profound human longing for peace. Such moments, alongside breakthroughs in cancer treatment, offer glimpses of hope in a world often marked by conflict and suffering. Yahweh blesses those who work towards reconciliation and healing, reflecting His own character.
reflection.zh: 国家间暂停敌对行动的消息，无论多么短暂，都提醒我们人类对和平的深切渴望。这样的时刻，以及癌症治疗的突破，为一个常被冲突和苦难困扰的世界带来了希望的曙光。雅伟赐福那些致力于和解与医治的人，因为他们反映了祂的品格。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Tories and Reform UK tell Burnham they will fight any plan to reform adult social care involving tax rises – UK politics live
title.zh: 保守党和改革英国党告诉伯纳姆，他们将反对任何涉及增税的成人社会护理改革计划——英国政治直播

summary.en: Political parties in the UK are clashing over proposed tax increases to fund reforms in adult social care. Andy Burnham has criticized the current council tax system as unfair, while the opposition vows to fight any tax-raising plans for social care.
summary.zh: 英国各政党就拟议的成人社会护理改革增税计划发生冲突。安迪·伯纳姆批评目前的市政税制度不公平，而反对党则誓言反对任何为社会护理增税的计划。

body.en: Defence secretary Wes Streeting says the country will see a prime minister that ‘runs towards big and difficult issues’ Andy Burnham has said there are “big decisions” ahead of his government on council tax, as he criticised the unfairness of the current system for making some people pay higher rates than are levied on more expensive homes in London. In his interview with Laura Kuenssberg for the BBC’s Panorama programme, Burnham said: There are people here in Greater Manchester who pay a much higher council tax than people living in much larger homes in London. So the chancellor before, Rachel Reeves, was right to start to reform council tax to create some fairness there in relation to people in homes that are of much greater value, who haven’t seen their council tax go up over the years because of the failure to revalue the banding. We need to honour the manifesto upon which Labour was elected, and if I was to bring forward any changes, obviously people would rightly say, well, is this consistent with that manifesto? So there are big decisions ahead, you are right about that. Two models are competing for support: a proportional property tax, which would replace both council tax and stamp duty with a flat 0.48 per cent annual charge on a home’s current value; or a land value tax – an annual charge based on the value of the land a property sits on, rather than the building. Continue reading...
body.zh: 国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷表示，英国将出现一位“致力于解决重大而困难的问题”的总理安迪·伯纳姆表示，他的政府在市政税问题上需要做出“重大决定”，他批评现行制度的不公平性，因为它让一些人支付的税率高于伦敦更昂贵房屋的税率。伯纳姆在接受英国广播公司全景节目劳拉·库恩斯伯格采访时表示：大曼彻斯特的人们缴纳的市政税比住在伦敦大得多的房子里的人要高得多。因此，前任财政大臣雷切尔·里夫斯（Rachel Reeves）开始改革市政税，为那些拥有价值更高的房屋的人们创造一些公平性，这是正确的，这些人多年来没有看到市政税因为未能重新估价而上涨。我们需要尊重工党当选时所依据的宣言，如果我要提出任何改变，显然人们会正确地说，这与该宣言一致吗？所以未来有重大决定，你是对的。有两种模式正在争夺支持：比例财产税，将取代市政税和印花税，每年按房屋当前价值征收 0.48% 的固定费用；或土地增值税——根据房产所在土地而不是建筑物的价值收取的年度费用。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The political debate over adult social care funding highlights the difficult choices governments face in ensuring a just society. Yahweh's call to leaders has always been to "do justice and righteousness," especially for the vulnerable. This reminds us that true governance involves protecting those who are most in need, even when it requires challenging...
reflection.zh: 围绕成人社会护理资金的政治辩论，凸显了政府在确保社会公正方面所面临的艰难抉择。雅伟对领袖的呼召始终是“施行公平和公义”，特别是为了那些弱势群体。这提醒我们，真正的治理在于保护最需要帮助的人，即便这需要对共享资源做出富有挑战性的决定。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Trump’s deportation crackdown accelerated by potent court tool
title.zh: 特朗普政府利用强力法庭工具加速驱逐行动

summary.en: The second Trump administration recorded its highest number of immigration arrests last month, accelerating deportation processes through potent court tools like mass hearings and 'in absentia' removal orders.
summary.zh: 第二届特朗普政府上月录得迄今为止最高的移民逮捕人数，通过大规模听证会和“缺席”驱逐令等强力法院工具加速了驱逐程序。

body.en: Mass hearings, removal orders ‘in absentia’ – judges are wrapping up immigration cases in unprecedented numbers The second Trump administration recorded its highest number of immigration arrests so far last month. One significant and alarming reason that is far less noticeable than armored, masked agents swaggering in the streets with weapons may be a sudden change in America’s immigration courts. Here, in recent months, accelerated mass hearings are giving people facing existential questions about their future little time to prepare for their cases, and judges are often ordering vulnerable immigrants deported without them even being in the courtroom. Continue reading...
body.zh: 大规模听证会、“缺席”驱逐令——法官正在以前所未有的数量结束移民案件特朗普第二届政府上个月创下了迄今为止最高的移民逮捕人数。一个重要且令人震惊的原因可能是美国移民法庭的突然变化，这一原因远不如全副武装、蒙面特工在街上大摇大摆地携带武器。近几个月来，加速举行的大规模听证会让那些面临着未来生存问题的人们几乎没有时间准备案件，而法官经常在弱势移民不在法庭的情况下下令将他们驱逐出境。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news reminds us of Yahweh's ancient command to treat foreigners residing among us with the same dignity and care as native-born citizens. It challenges us to reflect on how our systems and policies reflect compassion for those seeking a new home. May we consider the human impact of such measures and uphold the principle of loving our neighbor,...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们雅伟古老的诫命，要以对待本地公民同样的尊严和关怀对待居住在我们中间的外国人。它挑战我们反思，我们的制度和政策如何体现对寻求新家园者的怜悯。愿我们思考这些措施对人的影响，并秉持爱邻舍的原则，特别是对那些脆弱的陌生人。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Republicans have ‘nothing to run on’ in midterms after Trump failures, Jeffries says
title.zh: 杰弗里斯称共和党在中期选举中“无计可施”，因特朗普执政失败

summary.en: Top House Democrat Hakeem Jeffries stated that the Republican party has “nothing to run on” for the congressional midterm elections, asserting that former President Donald Trump “failed to deliver” on campaign promises to lower costs and avoid overseas wars.
summary.zh: 众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯表示，共和党在中期选举中“无计可施”，因为前总统唐纳德·特朗普未能兑现降低成本和避免海外战争的竞选承诺。

body.en: Top House Democrat says US president ‘failed to deliver’ on campaign promises to lower costs and avoid overseas wars Donald Trump ’s Republican party has “nothing to run on” for the congressional midterm elections after the president broke promises to lower costs and avoid starting war overseas, Hakeem Jeffries has said. The House minority leader, a New York congressman, made those comments on CNN’s State of the Union on Sunday, exactly 100 days from the 3 November midterms, when Jeffries and his fellow Democrats are aiming to take control of the US House and Senate from their Republican opponents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 众议院民主党高层表示，美国总统“未能兑现”降低成本和避免海外战争的竞选承诺哈基姆·杰弗里斯表示，在总统违背了降低成本和避免海外战争的承诺后，唐纳德·特朗普的共和党在国会中期选举中“毫无立足之地”。这位众议院少数党领袖、纽约国会议员于周日在 CNN 的国情咨文节目中发表了上述评论，此时距 11 月 3 日中期选举正好 100 天，杰弗里斯和他的民主党同僚的目标是从共和党对手手中夺取美国众议院和参议院的控制权。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news reminds us that the effectiveness of leadership profoundly impacts the daily lives of citizens. Proverbs 29:2 suggests that when leaders act righteously, the people flourish, but when they fail, the populace suffers. It underscores the deep connection between governance and the well-being of a nation, a principle Yahweh upholds for all who lead.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们，领导层的效能深刻影响着公民的日常生活。箴言29:2指出，当义人掌权时，百姓就喜乐；当恶人统治时，百姓就悲叹。这强调了治理与国家福祉之间的深层联系，这是雅伟为所有掌权者所设立的原则。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: British YouTuber Yung Filly describes night he met fan in Australian nightclub before allegedly raping her
title.zh: 英国YouTuber Yung Filly描述在澳大利亚夜店与粉丝相遇之夜，被控性侵

summary.en: A British YouTuber and musician is currently on trial, facing six charges of sexually penetrating a 20-year-old woman without consent. The court was told that the performer, known as Yung Filly, allegedly never asked the fan if she wanted sex after a gig.
summary.zh: 一名英国YouTuber兼音乐人目前正在受审，面临六项未经同意性侵一名20岁女性的指控。法庭获悉，这位名为Yung Filly的表演者在演出后，据称从未询问过该粉丝是否愿意发生性关系。

body.en: Performer on trial on six charges of sexually penetrating a 20-year-old woman without consent A British YouTuber and musician accused of violently raping a fan after a gig never asked his alleged victim if she wanted sex, a court has been told. Rapper Yung Filly, whose real name is Andrés Felipe Valencia Barrientos, is fighting six charges of sexually penetrating a 20-year-old woman without consent in a Perth hotel room in September 2024. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一名表演者因未经同意对一名 20 岁女性进行性侵六项罪名而受审 法庭获悉，一名英国 YouTuber 兼音乐家被控在一场演出后暴力强奸一名歌迷，但从未询问受害者是否想要发生性关系。说唱歌手 Yung Filly 的真名是 Andrés Felipe Valencia Barrientos，他正在对抗 2024 年 9 月在珀斯一家酒店房间未经同意对一名 20 岁女性进行性侵的六项指控。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news story highlights the profound violation that occurs when a person's bodily autonomy is disregarded. Yahweh's word reminds us that our bodies are sacred, not our own to be used or abused, but temples of the Holy Spirit. This truth underscores the deep respect and consent due to every individual, recognizing their inherent dignity and worth.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻故事凸显了当一个人的身体自主权被漠视时所发生的严重侵犯。雅伟的话语提醒我们，我们的身体是神圣的，不属于我们自己可以随意使用或滥用，而是圣灵的殿。这一真理强调了对每个个体应有的深切尊重和同意，承认其固有的尊严和价值。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own.
verse.textZh: 岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从神而来，住在你们里面的。并且你们不是自己的人。

title.en: Infantino tells Fifa critics to 'meditate, pray or watch football'
title.zh: 因凡蒂诺告诉国际足联批评者“冥想、祈祷或观看足球”

summary.en: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has responded to critics by suggesting they "meditate, pray or watch a football match" instead of "spreading hate and false rumours" about him and the World Cup.
summary.zh: 国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺回应批评者，建议他们“冥想、祈祷或观看足球比赛”，而不是“散布关于他本人和世界杯的仇恨和虚假谣言”。

body.en:
Fifa president Gianni Infantino has told critics to "meditate, pray or watch a football match" instead of "spreading hate and false rumours" about his leadership, the governing body and the World Cup.

In a 15-slide post on his personal Instagram account - reposted to Fifa's eight million followers - Infantino addressed "those behind their pens and papers, behind their screens" to affirm his belief that, while they were "busy planting seeds of hate", Fifa was delivering the "greatest event on earth".

He said the World Cup "celebrated humanity at its best", adding that the 2026 tournament had "100% safety and security, only joy and happiness".

Infantino downplayed several of the tournament's high-profile controversies and hailed the involvement of Iran, who featured at the World Cup despite their ongoing conflict with co-hosts the United States, as a success.

He said Fifa "worked tirelessly to unite two countries at war", with Iran entering the country "without incident or conflict".

His comments are in stark contradiction to those of Iran's head coach Amir Ghalenoei, who said his team were the "most oppressed" at the World Cup.

Iran faced visa delays, "integral" members of their backroom staff were denied entry to the US and fans had their allocation of tickets revoked, while Iran also had to move their training base from Tucson, Arizona to Tijuana, Mexico following a multitude of logistical issues in the build up to the tournament.

They later also encountered restrictions on their movements as they travelled between their training base and group matches in Los Angeles and Seattle.

Such issues were not unique to Iran, with fans from Haiti, Senegal, and Ivory Coast impacted by travel bans imposed by the Trump administration, while Somali referee Omar Artan was denied entry to the US - despite holding a diplomatic passport and a single entry US visa - because of his "association with suspected members of terror organisations".

Infantino wrote: "You mentioned the few people denied visas and overlooked the millions who were approved, from all parts of the world. Because football unites the world, and it was impressively demonstrated this summer."

Doubling down on the tournament's safety, Infantino said there were "zero incidents, zero violence, just joy, emotions, happiness, unity, and togetherness".

However, Fifa is investigating Argentina's actions after players and backroom staff were involved in altercations with Spain's players after losing the World Cup final. It is also investigating allegations of racist abuse towards American social media influencer IShowSpeed, while supporters were arrested at multiple matches - including following England's semi-final against Argentina in Atlanta.

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officials...
body.zh: 国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺告诉批评者“冥想、祈祷或观看足球比赛”，而不是“散布关于他的领导、管理机构和世界杯的仇恨和虚假谣言”。 因凡蒂诺在他的个人 Instagram 账户上发布了 15 张幻灯片（转发给国际足联 800 万粉丝），他对“那些在笔和纸后面、在屏幕后面的人”发表了讲话，以证实他的信念，即当他们“忙着播下仇恨的种子”时，国际足联正在举办“地球上最伟大的活动”。 他表示，世界杯“庆祝了人类最好的一面”，并补充说2026年的世界杯“100%安全，只有欢乐和幸福”。 因凡蒂诺淡化了本届世界杯的几项备受瞩目的争议，并称赞伊朗队的参与是一次成功。 他表示，国际足联“不懈地努力团结两个交战国家”，伊朗“没有发生任何事件或冲突”进入该国。 他的言论与伊朗主教练阿米尔·加勒诺伊的言论形成鲜明对比，后者表示伊朗队是世界杯上“最受压迫的”球队。 伊朗面临签证延误，其幕后工作人员的“重要”成员被拒绝进入美国，球迷的门票分配被撤销，而伊朗还不得不将其训练基地从亚利桑那州图森迁至墨西哥蒂华纳，因为世界杯筹备过程中出现了众多后勤问题。 后来，他们在洛杉矶和西雅图的训练基地和小组赛之间往返时也遇到了行动限制。 这些问题并非伊朗独有，来自海地、塞内加尔和科特迪瓦的球迷受到特朗普政府实施的旅行禁令的影响，而索马里裁判奥马尔·阿坦（Omar Artan）尽管持有外交护照和单次入境美国签证，但因“与恐怖组织嫌疑成员有联系”而被拒绝入境美国。 因凡蒂诺写道：“你提到了少数人被拒绝签证，却忽视了来自世界各地的数百万人获得批准。因为足球将世界团结在一起，今年夏天这一点令人印象深刻。” 因凡蒂诺强调赛事安全，表示“零事故、零暴力，只有欢乐、情感、幸福、团结和团结”。 然而，在输掉世界杯决赛后，球员和幕后工作人员与西班牙球员发生争执，国际足联正在调查阿根廷队的行为。它还正在调查针对美国社交媒体影响者 IShowSpeed 的种族主义虐待指控，而支持者在多场比赛中被捕 - 包括英格兰在亚特兰大对阵阿根廷的半决赛后。 移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 官员...

reflection.en: In public life, it is easy to dismiss criticism by questioning the motives of those who speak against us. Yet, wisdom reminds us to hear every side of a matter before forming a judgment. This encourages a posture of discernment, seeking to understand rather than immediately rejecting dissenting voices.
reflection.zh: 在公共生活中，我们很容易通过质疑批评者的动机来驳斥他们的意见。然而，智慧提醒我们在做出判断之前要听取事情的各个方面。这鼓励我们采取一种明辨的态度，寻求理解而非立即拒绝不同的声音。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Rapper Yung Filly tells trial 'vibes were good' with woman who accuses him of rape
title.zh: 说唱歌手Yung Filly在庭审中称与指控他强奸的女子“气氛很好”

summary.en: Rapper Yung Filly testified in his rape trial in Australia, denying the accusation from a fan and stating that the “vibes were good” between them in the hotel room.
summary.zh: 说唱歌手Yung Filly在澳大利亚的强奸案审判中出庭作证，否认了一名粉丝的指控，并表示他们在酒店房间里“气氛很好”。

body.en:
UK rapper Yung Filly has told a court that the "vibes were good" between him and a woman he is accused of raping after performing at a nightclub in Australia in 2024.

The rapper, whose real name is Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, took the witness stand at the District Court of Western Australia on Monday - a week after the start of his trial.

He is accused of sexually assaulting the woman, then 20 years old, in his hotel room after he performed in Hillarys, a coastal suburb of Perth.

Barrientos, 30, has pleaded not guilty to six counts of sexual penetration without consent, three counts of assault occasioning bodily harm, and one count of strangulation.

Barrientos told the court he had "fancied" the woman when they met at the concert venue. He had been in the VIP area while she leaned over the barrier from the general area.

"I recall putting my hand on her waist," he told the court. But he said he had not put his hands down her pants or touched her breast.

The "vibes were good" between them later when they arrived at his hotel, Barrientos said.

His security guard took the woman's phone away - a "standard practice" to protect their privacy, according to Barrientos.

The court heard previously that the pair had engaged in consensual sex before Barrientos turned violent and she told him to stop.

Barrientos, who had been touring Australia at the time of the alleged offences, is also known for his work with the YouTube collective Beta Squad, and has appeared in the celebrity version of Bake Off on Channel 4 and presented BBC Three shows.

He has been on bail since being charged and was allowed to fly home to the UK in September for four months, before returning to Western Australia ahead of his trial.

In addition to his 1.8 million YouTube subscribers, he has three million followers on TikTok and and 2.4 million on Instagram.
body.zh: 英国说唱歌手 Yung Filly 在法庭上表示，他与一名被指控在 2024 年在澳大利亚一家夜总会表演后强奸的女子之间“气氛很好”。 这位说唱歌手的真名是安德烈斯·费利佩·瓦伦西亚·巴里恩托斯 (Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos)，周一（审判开始一周后）在西澳大利亚地方法院出庭作证。 他被指控在珀斯沿海郊区希拉里斯演出后在酒店房间对这名当时 20 岁的女子进行性侵犯。 30 岁的巴里恩托斯对六项未经同意的性侵罪名、三项袭击导致身体伤害罪名和一项勒死罪名表示不认罪。 巴里恩托斯告诉法庭，当他们在音乐会场地见面时，他“喜欢”了这名女子。当她从普通区靠在栅栏上时，他已经在贵宾区了。 “我记得我把手放在她的腰上，”他告诉法庭。但他说他没有把手伸进她的裤子或触摸她的乳房。 巴里恩托斯说，当他们到达他的酒店时，他们之间的“气氛很好”。 巴里恩托斯表示，他的保安拿走了这名女子的手机，这是保护他们隐私的“标准做法”。 法庭此前获悉，在巴里恩托斯变得暴力之前，两人曾发生过自愿性行为，她告诉他停止。 巴里恩托斯在涉嫌犯罪时正在澳大利亚巡回演出，他还因与 YouTube 集体 Beta Squad 的合作而闻名，并出现在第四频道的名人版《Bake Off》中，并主持了 BBC 三台节目。 自被指控以来，他一直处于保释状态，并被允许于 9 月飞回英国，为期四个月，然后在审判前返回西澳大利亚。 除了 180 万 YouTube 订阅者外，他还在 TikTok 上拥有 300 万粉丝，在 Instagram 上拥有 240 万粉丝。

reflection.en: In a trial, the truth often emerges as different accounts are presented and examined. This verse reminds us that initial impressions can be misleading, and true understanding requires hearing all sides. It underscores the importance of a thorough and impartial process in seeking justice.
reflection.zh: 在审判中，真相往往在不同陈述被提出和审查后浮现。这节经文提醒我们，最初的印象可能具有误导性，真正的理解需要倾听各方。它强调了在寻求公义过程中，彻底和公正的重要性。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Chinese chipmaker shares surge 470% in blockbuster stock market debut
title.zh: 中国芯片制造商股票首次上市交易飙升470%

summary.en: The company's shares soared by 470% in its market debut, as the AI boom drives chip demand.
summary.zh: 该公司股价在首次上市交易中飙升470%，原因是人工智能热潮推动了芯片需求。

body.en:
Shares in China's biggest memory chip maker have surged by more than 470% as they made their debut on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's tech-heavy Star Market.

The surge has pushed ChangXin Memory Technologies' (CXMT) stock market valuation to around 3.3 trillion yuan ($487.3bn; £364.9bn), making it the most valuable listed company in mainland China.

The spectacular debut comes despite a sharp sell-off in technology stocks around the world this month.

CXMT manufactures dynamic random-access memory (Dram) chips that power artificial intelligence (AI) data centres, mobile phones, PCs, tablets and other devices.

The firm, which was founded in 2016 by Chairman Zhu Yiming, is headquartered in Hefei, Anhui Province in eastern China.

The company has said it plans to use most of the proceeds from the initial public offering (IPO) to boost production of memory chips and carry out more research and developments.

The stellar performance of its IPO will offer some comfort to Chinese financial officials, who have been rolling out measures to help curb a stock market slump that wiped out more than $1.5tn in recent weeks.

Analysts said the jump was also being driven by demand for the shares far outstripping supply.

"The reason for the extraordinary bounce this morning is that only 7% of the shares are available for trading," Anna Macdonald, investment strategy director at Hargreaves Lansdown told the BBC's Today programme.

It also highlights Chinese investors' strong appetite for a homegrown chipmaker, as the government in Beijing pushes ahead with plans to make its technology industry self-reliant.

South Korean tech giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix and US-based Micron dominate the Dram market, with the three companies accounting for around 90% of global production.

Earlier this month, SK Hynix raised $26.5bn (£19.8bn) in its New York share offering , marking the largest ever listing by a foreign firm in the US.

The company, a key supplier to AI chip giant Nvidia, said it had sold 177.9 million American depositary shares for $149 each.

The shares surged as much as 17% on Friday in their first day of trading on the Nasdaq but have since given up some of that gain.

SK Hynix saw its market value top $1tn in its home country in May, lifted by the boom in demand for AI chips.
body.zh: 中国最大的存储芯片制造商在上海证券交易所以科技股为主的科创板上市后，其股价已飙升超过 470%。 这一飙升已将长鑫存储科技 (CXMT) 的股市估值推至约 3.3 万亿元人民币（4,873 亿美元；3,649 亿英镑），使其成为中国大陆市值最高的上市公司。 尽管本月全球科技股大幅抛售，但该股的首次亮相还是令人瞩目。 长鑫存储制造动态随机存取存储器 (Dram) 芯片，为人工智能 (AI) 数据中心、手机、个人电脑、平板电脑和其他设备提供动力。 该公司由董事长朱一鸣于2016年创立，总部位于中国东部安徽省合肥市。 该公司表示，计划将首次公开募股（IPO）的大部分收益用于提高存储芯片的产量并进行更多的研发。 其IPO的出色表现将为中国金融官员带来一些安慰，他们一直在推出措施帮助遏制股市暴跌，股市在最近几周损失了超过1.5兆美元。 分析师表示，股价上涨的另一个原因是对该股的需求远远超过供应。 Hargreaves Lansdown 投资策略总监安娜·麦克唐纳 (Anna Macdonald) 告诉 BBC 的《Today》节目：“今天上午出现异常反弹的原因是，只有 7% 的股票可供交易。” 随着北京政府推进科技行业自力更生的计划，这也凸显了中国投资者对本土芯片制造商的强烈兴趣。 韩国科技巨头三星电子、SK 海力士和美国美光在 DRAM 市场占据主导地位，这三家公司的产量约占全球产量的 90%。 本月早些时候，SK 海力士在纽约股票发行中筹集了 265 亿美元（198 亿英镑），这是外国公司在美国上市以来规模最大的一次。 该公司是人工智能芯片巨头英伟达的主要供应商，表示已以每股 149 美元的价格出售了 1.779 亿股美国存托股票。 周五，该股在纳斯达克上市首日飙升 17%，但此后回吐了部分涨幅。 受人工智能芯片需求旺盛的推动，SK 海力士 5 月份在本国的市值突破 1 万亿美元。

reflection.en: A remarkable stock market debut highlights the rapid creation of wealth in today's tech landscape. Amidst such prosperity, Deuteronomy 8:18 reminds us that it is Yahweh who gives us the ability to produce wealth. This encourages us to remember the ultimate source of all blessings and to steward resources with gratitude and wisdom.
reflection.zh: 此次引人注目的股票上市首秀凸显了当今科技领域财富的快速增长。在这样的繁荣之中，申命记8:18提醒我们，是雅伟赐予我们获取财富的能力。这鼓励我们在一切蒙福之中，铭记所有恩典的最终来源，并以感恩和智慧管理资源。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
title.zh: 英国首相承诺在泽连斯基访问前继续支持乌克兰

summary.en: The UK Prime Minister has pledged ongoing assistance to Ukraine, with the Ukrainian president scheduled to be his first international visitor since assuming office.
summary.zh: 英国首相承诺将继续支持乌克兰，乌克兰总统将是其上任以来的首位国际访客。

body.en:
Andy Burnham has pledged to continue the UK's "unwavering" support for Ukraine ahead of meeting Volodymyr Zelensky on Monday.

The Ukrainian president will become the prime minister's first international visitor since he took office a week ago, which No 10 said "illustrates the strength of the relationship between the two nations".

They will visit a naval base, where Burnham will announce the sharing of the intellectual property behind the UK's new "Stone Cloak" electronic warfare system, enabling Ukraine to produce the technology at scale.

Burnham told the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg ahead of the visit that he was looking forward to it and that his support for Ukraine was "unwavering - it is 100%".

The Stone Cloak jammers are the size of a tablet computer and are designed to block the detection of any drones they are fitted to.

The Ministry of Defence has already given thousands of the devices to Ukrainian forces to bolster their drone operations.

Downing Street said that following its deployment in Ukraine, the technology will be built into the UK's next generation of long-range weapons.

It said this would include Project Brakestop, a government programme to develop low-cost cruise missiles - self-propelled guided weapons that fly like normal aircraft for much of their flight.

Burnham said in a statement on Sunday evening: "Stone Cloak is the best of homegrown British innovation and proven on the frontline, and it will be vital to protecting our security in both our countries."

During Monday's visit, the two leaders will also meet more than 200 Ukrainian military personnel who have spent the last three weeks taking part in a maritime exercise in the UK.

Exercise Sea Breeze is aimed at strengthening warfighting capabilities and counter-mine measures in the Black Sea.

Britain's backing of Ukraine has been constant since Russia's invasion four years ago, and the UK has committed £25bn in funding , external for the country's warfighting efforts.

In one of his first calls after becoming prime minister last Monday, Burnham spoke to Zelensky and invited him to visit the UK "at the earliest opportunity".

Zelensky wrote on X shortly afterwards: "I truly appreciate that the support for Ukraine and our people will remain steadfast."

Burnham's predecessor, Sir Keir Starmer, visited Kyiv on his final full day as Labour leader.

During that trip, he announced fresh funding worth £255m (€300m) for Ukraine's fight against Russia and was awarded Ukraine's Order of Freedom.

Asked if he was concerned about changes of leadership in Britain, and in France next year, Zelensky said: "Of course I'm afraid of changes, of course we are afraid because we are in the war each day.

"But again the priority is the relation between nations, not just between just people....
body.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆承诺在周一会见弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基之前，英国将继续“坚定不移”地支持乌克兰。 乌克兰总统将成为总理一周前就职以来的首位国际访问者，10号称这“体现了两国关系的强度”。 他们将参观一个海军基地，伯纳姆将在那里宣布分享英国新型“石斗篷”电子战系统背后的知识产权，使乌克兰能够大规模生产该技术。 伯纳姆在访问前对 BBC 的劳拉·昆斯伯格表示，他对此充满期待，并且他对乌克兰的支持“坚定不移——100%”。 石斗篷干扰器的大小与平板电脑相当，旨在阻止检测到它们所安装的任何无人机。 国防部已经向乌克兰军队提供了数千台此类设备，以支持他们的无人机行动。 唐宁街表示，在乌克兰部署后，该技术将被内置到英国的下一代远程武器中。 据称，这将包括“刹车计划”（Project Brakestop），这是一项开发低成本巡航导弹的政府计划，这种巡航导弹是一种自行式制导武器，在大部分飞行过程中可以像普通飞机一样飞行。 伯纳姆在周日晚间的一份声明中表示：“石斗篷是英国本土最好的创新，并在前线得到了验证，它对于保护我们两国的安全至关重要。” 在周一访问期间，两位领导人还将会见过去三周在英国参加海上演习的 200 多名乌克兰军事人员。 “海风”演习旨在加强黑海的作战能力和反水雷措施。 自四年前俄罗斯入侵以来，英国一直对乌克兰提供持续支持，并且英国已承诺提供 250 亿英镑的外部资金，用于该国的作战行动。 伯纳姆上周一就任英国首相后的第一次通话中，他与泽连斯基通话，并邀请他“尽早”访问英国。 不久后，泽连斯基在 X 上写道：“我真的很感激乌克兰和我们人民将继续坚定不移的支持。” 伯纳姆的前任凯尔·斯塔默爵士在作为工党领袖的最后一天访问了基辅。 在那次访问期间，他宣布为乌克兰对抗俄罗斯的斗争提供价值 2.55 亿英镑（3 亿欧元）的新资金，并被授予乌克兰自由勋章。 当被问及是否担心英国和明年法国的领导层变动时，泽伦斯基说：“我当然害怕变化，我们当然害怕，因为我们每天都在战争中。 “但同样，优先事项是国家之间的关系，而不仅仅是人与人之间的关系......

reflection.en: In times of prolonged conflict and devastation, the commitment to "continued support" echoes the enduring faithfulness of Yahweh, whose mercies are new every morning. This diplomatic pledge reminds us that sustained solidarity is vital for those facing relentless challenges, offering a steady hand of help when hope might otherwise wane.
reflection.zh: 在长期冲突和破坏的时期，“持续支持”的承诺呼应了雅伟永不停止的信实，祂的怜悯每天早晨都是新的。这一外交承诺提醒我们，对于那些面临严峻挑战的人来说，持续的团结至关重要，能在希望可能消退时提供稳定的帮助。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Australian court upholds racial discrimination ruling against Pauline Hanson
title.zh: 澳大利亚法院维持对宝琳·汉森种族歧视的裁决

summary.en: An Australian court has upheld a ruling that One Nation leader Pauline Hanson racially discriminated against Senator Mehreen Faruqi, rejecting Hanson's appeal.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚一家法院维持了对“一国党”领袖宝琳·汉森种族歧视参议员梅赫琳·法鲁奇的裁决，驳回了汉森的上诉。

body.en:
Australian populist leader Pauline Hanson racially discriminated against a Muslim senator in a 2022 tweet by telling her to return to Pakistan, a court has said, upholding an earlier ruling.

The One Nation party leader had appealed a 2024 ruling that she had breached the racial discrimination act when she responded to a post by Senator Mehreen Faruqi with an "angry personal attack" that was "anti-Muslim".

Hanson had argued at the Federal Court that political communication should be protected but Justice Melissa Perry dismissed her appeal on Monday.

"Today's win is for every single person who has been made to feel that their belonging in this country is conditional," Faruqi said outside court.

"This case was always about holding to account racism and holding to account those who perpetrate racism," she added. "Hate speech is not free speech."

On the day of the death of Queen Elizabeth II in September 2022, Faruqi had offered condolences to those who mourned for the queen in a social media post. But, she added, "I cannot mourn the leader of a racist empire built on stolen lives, land and wealth of colonized people."

Hanson responded with a post that was "a variant of the slogan, 'go back to where you came from'", Judge Angus Stewart ruled in 2024. The phrase was "a racist trope with a long history", and "implicitly" targeted Muslims, he said.

Faruqi, the deputy leader of the Greens party, took Hanson to court after the tweet was posted, arguing it breached the racial discrimination act.

It was reasonably likely to offend, insult, humiliate or intimidate another person or group of people and was done because of her race, colour or national or ethnic origin, she argued.

Hanson said she was "disappointed" with the decision and that she and her legal team would review it "with a view to commencing an appeal in the High Court of Australia".

Hanson has in the past advocated for a "Muslim ban" on immigration and earlier this year attracted criticism for an interview in which she suggested there were no "good" Muslims.

This month Hanson denied that she was advocating for a return of the "White Australia" policy - when from 1901 to the 1970s the nation banned non-white immigrants - in a podcast with British far-right activist Tommy Robinson.

In the podcast, Robinson asked Hanson how Australia had ended up with "Pakistanis, Somalis, all of these African problems with violent Africans?" to which Hanson responded that it began when "they opened up and got rid of the White Australian policy".
body.zh: 一家法院表示，澳大利亚民粹主义领导人宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 在 2022 年的一条推文中要求一名穆斯林参议员返回巴基斯坦，对她构成种族歧视，并维持了先前的裁决。 这位一国党领导人对2024年的一项裁决提出上诉，该裁决称她违反了种族歧视法，当时她以“反穆斯林”的“愤怒的人身攻击”回应了参议员梅林·法鲁奇(Mehreen Faruqi)的帖子。 汉森曾在联邦法院辩称，政治沟通应受到保护，但法官梅丽莎·佩里周一驳回了她的上诉。 法鲁奇在法庭外表示：“今天的胜利是为了每一个让他们感到自己在这个国家的归属是有条件的人。” 她补充说：“这个案件始终是要追究种族主义的责任，并追究那些实施种族主义的人的责任。” “仇恨言论不是言论自由。” 2022年9月伊丽莎白二世女王去世当天，法鲁奇在社交媒体帖子中向哀悼女王的人们表示哀悼。但是，她补充说，“我无法哀悼一个建立在被盗的殖民地人民的生命、土地和财富之上的种族主义帝国的领导人。” 法官安格斯·斯图尔特 (Angus Stewart) 在 2024 年裁定，汉森发布的帖子是“‘回到你来自的地方’这一口号的变体”。他说，这句话是“历史悠久的种族主义比喻”，并且“暗中”针对穆斯林。 这条推文发布后，绿党副党魁法鲁奇将汉森告上法庭，称其违反了种族歧视法。 她认为，这种行为很可能冒犯、侮辱、羞辱或恐吓另一个人或一群人，而且是因为她的种族、肤色或民族或族裔出身而进行的。 汉森表示，她对这一决定“感到失望”，她和她的法律团队将对其进行审查，“以期向澳大利亚高等法院提起上诉”。 汉森过去曾主张对移民实行“穆斯林禁令”，今年早些时候，她因在一次采访中暗示没有“好”穆斯林而招致批评。 本月，汉森在与英国极右活动人士汤米·罗宾逊 (Tommy Robinson) 的播客中否认她主张回归“白澳大利亚”政策——从 1901 年到 1970 年代，该国禁止非白人移民。 在播客中，罗宾逊问汉森，澳大利亚是如何导致“巴基斯坦人、索马里人，所有这些非洲问题都与暴力非洲人有关的？”汉森回应说，这始于“他们开放并摆脱了澳大利亚白人政策”。

reflection.en: This court decision underscores the importance of treating all individuals with dignity and respect, regardless of their background. Yahweh's word reminds us that in Christ, distinctions of race or origin are transcended, as we are all one. May we strive to build societies where every person's inherent worth is recognized and protected.
reflection.zh: 这项法院裁决强调了无论背景如何，都应以尊严和尊重对待所有个人的重要性。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在基督里，种族或出身的区分已被超越，因为我们都是一体的。愿我们努力建设一个承认并保护每个人固有价值的社会。

verse.textEn: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verse.textZh: 并不分犹太人、希利尼人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。

title.en: Israeli settlers torch two mosques in West Bank during a deadly surge in violence
title.zh: 以色列定居者在致命暴力激增期间焚烧约旦河西岸两座清真寺

summary.en: Violence in the Israeli-occupied West Bank has escalated since the Gaza war began, with recent incidents including Israeli settlers setting fire to two mosques.
summary.zh: 自加沙战争爆发以来，以色列占领的约旦河西岸暴力事件激增，近期事件包括以色列定居者焚烧了两座清真寺。

body.en:
Two mosques in the Israeli-occupied West Bank were set on fire overnight in an apparent Israeli settler attack, officials said overnight, after a spate of deadly violence that killed four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers.

Palestinians and the Israeli opposition accuse Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's hard-line government of turning a blind eye to attacks by settlers against Palestinians , which threaten to ignite widespread violence across the territory.

Israeli soldiers and police fanned out across the West Bank after the attack, closing off major roads and blocking access to a hospital. Israel also arrested more than 70 Palestinians over the weekend.

The mosques, in the villages of Qusra and Kour in the northern West Bank, suffered extensive damage in the fires.

In Qusra, the attackers spray-painted "revenge Benayahu," referring to one of the settlers killed on Friday, and "the land of Israel is redeemed with blood".

title.en: US and Iran halt bombing for second night as both sides give space to talks
title.zh: 美国和伊朗暂停轰炸，为谈判创造空间

summary.en: A temporary halt in fighting between the US and Iran has occurred for a second night, as both nations face rising military costs and ongoing regional tensions.

body.en:
The United States has paused its bombing campaign against Iran for a second consecutive night, with both the US and Iran signalling a willingness to give diplomacy another chance after nearly two weeks of escalating military action.

The pause follows reports senior US military officials advised US President Donald Trump the bombing campaign had reached the limits of its effectiveness, while warning US stocks of key munitions were being depleted.

US ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz told Fox News that Trump had suspended strikes to create space for negotiations, while an Iranian official told the Reuters news agency Iran would also refrain from retaliatory attacks for as long as the US held its fire.

"Iran's position remains 'attack for attack': if the attacks stop, Iran will also halt its operations," the official said, adding Iran remained prepared to respond if US attacks resumed.

Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said messages continued to be exchanged with the US through mediators, although he accused the US of previously having "betrayed" negotiations.

Before the latest pause, the US carried out a 13th consecutive night of strikes on Friday, targeting what the military said were Iranian command centres, drone storage facilities and maritime capabilities linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

Iranian state media reported at least four people were killed in the south-western province of Khuzestan, while Iran responded by launching drones and missiles towards US military facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan.

Authorities in Bahrain, Jordan and Kuwait said their air defence systems intercepted many of the attacks.

The pause comes as the financial and military toll of the conflict continues to grow.

Repeated Iranian attacks on US military bases across the Middle East have left parts of the US' regional military network heavily damaged.

The attacks have hit facilities in Kuwait, Jordan, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, with defence experts saying they have exposed vulnerabilities in sites once considered secure, and signalled a new chapter for the US' longstanding military strategy in the Middle East.

According to Pentagon figures, the war has already cost the United States US$37.5 billion ($53.6 billion), with politicians approving further military spending as concerns mount over the long-term impact on its defence capabilities.

title.en: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot dead by German police
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行袭击案嫌疑人被德国警方击毙

summary.en: German police shot dead a suspect involved in a Berlin Pride attack. The individual was known to authorities for numerous previous crimes and was believed to have been radicalised.
summary.zh: 德国警方击毙了一名柏林骄傲游行袭击案嫌疑人。该嫌疑人此前因大量犯罪行为而为当局所知，并被认为已激进化。

body.en:
The suspect in the deadly Berlin Pride attack that left one person dead and 29 injured was shot and killed by police during a confrontation overnight, authorities said.

Abdul Ballout, a German citizen, was killed following a search that lasted nearly 24 hours after the attack in downtown Berlin.

Ballout, 21, was suspected of driving a van into a crowd near Berlin’s Pride festival on Saturday night (local time) before apparently stabbing others with a machete.

German interior minister Alexander Dobrindt said the attack occurred a few hundred metres from a party near the Brandenburg Gate that was supposed to close out the city's Pride festival.

Ballout was tracked down at around 2am AEST on Monday at a garden in Spandau, a Berlin suburb, the city's police department said in a post on X. They said he apparently ran toward officers with a sharp instrument, and police fired at least one shot. He died at the scene.

Ballout was born in Germany, the minister said. His mother was naturalised in 2002, three years before he was born.

Dobrindt said Ballout had been known to the authorities for a "high number" of previous crimes and for being radicalised.

"Everything we see here indicates that this was an Islamist terror attack," he said.

Prosecutors said Ballout had previous convictions for bodily harm and extortion committed in 2019, and one for robbery in 2020.

They say that in 2024 he shared IS propaganda on Instagram and the following year travelled to Lebanon in order to fight for the militia in Syria.

He was arrested in Lebanon and sentenced to three months' prison for offences including incitement to religious and sectarian conflict.

He returned to Germany after completing his sentence, where he was arrested at the Berlin airport.

In May, a juvenile court in Berlin convicted Ballout of preparing a serious act of violence endangering the state, as well as publishing the self-proclaimed Islamic State (IS) group's propaganda on his Instagram account and other charges, prosecutors said.

The court handed down a suspended sentence of one year and 10 months in youth custody, which Berlin prosecutors had appealed.

The court said it took Ballout’s months of pre-trial detention in Germany and Lebanon into account. It also said it considered that Ballout had confessed to the crimes, appeared to distance himself from the militant group, and no actual threat had ever materialised.

title.en: Berlin Pride attack: What we know so far
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行袭击：我们目前所知

summary.en: On Saturday, a vehicle drove into a crowd near a Christopher Street Day celebration in Berlin, in what is being regarded as an attack on the LGBTQ+ community. The main suspect was confronted and shot dead.
summary.zh: 周六，一辆汽车在柏林克里斯托弗街日庆祝活动附近冲入人群，这被视为对LGBTQ+社区的袭击。主要嫌疑人随后被制服并击毙。

body.en:
On Saturday, a vehicle drove into a crowd near a Christopher Street Day celebration in what is being regarded as an attack on the LGBTQ+ community. The main suspect has since been confronted and shot dead.

On Saturday night, around 10 p.m., a white van drove into a crowd some 100 meters (328 feet) away from a Christopher Street Day celebration near Brandenburg Gate in the heart of Berlin. Police spokesperson Florian Nath said the van drove through the park parallel to a main road and struck a number of people before crashing into a tree. Afterward, the driver left the van and fled in an unknown direction, Nath said. 

Police later confirmed the vehicle was privately owned, not a rental. It was removed from the crime scene on Sunday.

Federal Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt (CDU) later added that a suspect is also believed to have attacked people with a blade-like weapon, possibly a machete, before fleeing.

The area around the crime scene was widely blocked off Saturday night after organizers called off the rest of the event and evacuated festivalgoers. Police searched the Tiergarten area with infrared cameras overnight, spokesperson Nath said.

One woman died following the attack, and 29 people were injured — several of them severely.

"This is an attack on our society," German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on social media in response to the attack, which he called "heinous." The people struck were near a closing party of the Christopher Street Day parade, which celebrates LGBTQ+ rights .

By Sunday afternoon, police confirmed that none of those injured were in life-threatening condition anymore.

Eyewitness accounts initially suggested that multiple attackers were involved, leading the police to search for more than one perpetrator at first. 

Interior Minister Dobrindt said Sunday the chief suspect was Abdul B., 21, who had been known to authorities for a "high number" of previous attacks, and for being radicalized. In accordance with the German press code, Deutsche Welle refrains from publishing the full name of criminal suspects.

Prosecutors say Abdul B. shared propaganda for the so-called Islamic State (or  IS ) militant group online and had recently unsuccessfully attempted to join the group in Syria.

He later distanced himself from IS. Abdul B. was born in Germany and held German citizenship. His mother has Lebanese origins. 

On Sunday evening, Berlin's Senate Department for Interior Affairs told media the fugitive suspect Abdul B. was shot dead in a police operation in a garden allotment in Spandau, Berlin's westernmost borough. The interior minister has since said there was no longer any danger to the public.

title.en: Australia's favourite holiday destination is undergoing a hidden transformation
title.zh: 澳大利亚人最喜爱的度假胜地正在经历一场隐秘的变革

summary.en: Bali's waste crisis is colliding with a boom in tourists, and the Indonesian government has plans to reel in more rich visitors.
summary.zh: 巴厘岛的垃圾危机正与旅游业的蓬勃发展相冲突，而印度尼西亚政府计划吸引更多富裕游客。

body.en:
Since Bali's main landfill site, Suwung, closed in April, bags of rubbish and single-use plastics have piled up in the streets, on the beaches and in the canals.

"The air is no longer fresh; the views are clouded by haze; and the sweet scent of frangipani has been replaced by the acrid smell of burning plastic," Balinese writer Sugi Lanus posted on social media.

In June the Balinese government partially reopened the landfill to organic waste, limited to two days a week. Officials had wanted to close it for years, as the central Indonesian government pushes to end open-air waste dumping.

At the same time, tourism to Bali has hit an all-time peak. Last year, visitors increased by nearly 10 per cent to hit just under seven million visitors.

But as Indonesia paves the way for more tourists, with a master plan to transform Bali into the "Dubai" of Southeast Asia, it's the local communities who are left to shoulder the burden of Bali's environmental emergency.

Made Suarnatha, who started environmental NGO Wisnu Foundation in Bali in 1993, told SBS News Bali's waste crisis was "a political issue".

He said the landfill closure masked an existing problem with the transition from mostly organic waste to plastic waste — a problem intensified by tourism.

"You come here as a tourist, you need food, you need water, you make trips here and there, so you bring waste as a consequence," he said.

"It's no big issue when we talk about waste which is mostly organic, but the tourism industry comes, and the character of the waste changes to packaging with plastic, cardboard, metal, and everything," he said.

"It changed its character without being followed by an understanding of how to handle it."

Putu Natih, an economist at Universitas Indonesia, grew up visiting family in Bali.

She told SBS News that of the roughly 3,436 tonnes of waste generated every day in Bali, around 40 per cent is burned or illegally dumped.

"The failure is more likely structural rather than behavioural. The regulation exists, but the collection and processing infrastructure to back it up does not," Natih said.

title.en: Berlin Pride: Latest in string of deadly vehicle attacks
title.zh: 柏林骄傲节：一系列致命车辆袭击中的最新一起

summary.en: A recent attack at a Berlin Pride event, where a vehicle was used as a weapon, is part of a growing trend of similar incidents globally. The United States, Canada, and China have also experienced such attacks in recent years.
summary.zh: 柏林骄傲节上发生的一起车辆被用作武器的袭击事件，是全球此类事件不断增多的一部分。近年来，美国、加拿大和中国也发生了类似的袭击。

body.en:
The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.

A Christopher Street Day event in the German capital, which attracts thousands of people every year, was attacked on Saturday night by a 21-year-old suspect who police said was associated with the "Islamist scene" in Berlin. One person was killed and another 16 people were injured, while the suspect, named as Abdul B., fled the scene.

Two people were killed and 20 more injured in early May when a car drove through a crowd in the eastern German city of Leipzig. The suspect in the case was described as a 33-year-old German national and local resident, who had been known to police, though not for relevant offenses.

At least two people were killed and several were injured in the southwestern German city of Mannheim in 2025 when a motorist intentionally drove his car into a crowd of people , according to police and public prosecutors. Authorities identified the suspect as a 40-year-old German man. Law enforcement ruled out a political motive at the time, though the man had paid a fine under Germany's hate crime laws for a comment he made on a social media platform in 2018.

A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old daughter were killed in Munich in February last year when a car was rammed into a demonstration organized by the trade union Verdi. A 25-year-old Afghan man subsequently went on trial for their murder, as well as the attempted murder of the dozens of other people injured in the attack. 

A vehicle plowed into a crowd of New Orleans revelers early on New Year's Day 2025, killing 14 people and injuring dozens of others. The driver of the vehicle and two police officers were killed in a firefight soon after the attack, which took place at about 3:15 in the morning local time. The FBI said it was investigating the incident as an act of terrorism.

At least six people died and more than 300 were injured when a man slammed a rented BMW SUV into a Christmas market in eastern Germany. The suspect, who was arrested at the scene, was a 50-year-old doctor originally from Saudi Arabia who had expressed anti-Muslim views and support for the far-right AfD party. In June 2026, he was sentenced to life in prison, with the court noting the severity of his crime, which more or less rules out the possibility of an early release.

title.en: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
title.zh: 巴控克什米尔选举能否平息紧张局势？

summary.en: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is preparing for elections following weeks of deadly protests. These demonstrations were sparked by disputes over parliamentary seats designated for individuals displaced from India-administered Kashmir, with one local faction advocating for an election boycott.
summary.zh: 巴控克什米尔地区在经历数周致命抗议后将举行选举。这些抗议活动源于对为印控克什米尔流离失所者保留的议会席位的争议，当地一个团体呼吁抵制此次选举。

body.en:
Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the elections to be boycotted.

The first phase of local elections in Pakistan-administered Kashmir is scheduled for Monday, July 27, amid calls for a boycott from the recently outlawed Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), a grassroots alliance of civil society groups.

The JAAC has been demanding the abolition of 12 seats in the regional assembly reserved for people displaced from India-administered Kashmir and living in Pakistan. The group argues that only residents of Pakistan-administered Kashmir should be eligible to contest regional elections.

The dispute escalated after the Supreme Court of Pakistan-administered Kashmir ruled that the refugee seats are constitutionally protected and cannot be abolished without a constitutional amendment.

The regional government outlawed the JAAC in June under anti-terrorism laws, citing threats to public order, and detained dozens of its supporters.

The ban came amid rising tensions over the refugee seats and ahead of violent protests sparked by the group's campaign to scrap them.

The unrest has left around 30 people dead since June, according to local estimates cited by Reuters news agency.

India and Pakistan both claim Kashmir in its entirety, but each country only controls a section of the territory, making the Muslim-majority region a longstanding flash point between the nuclear-armed neighbors since their independence from Britain in 1947.

Since early June, Pakistan-administered Kashmir — known locally as Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) — has witnessed weeks of protests and sit-ins. While the dispute over the refugee seats has become a major issue, JAAC has also campaigned for broader economic and governance reforms. 

Following the unrest, authorities split polling into three phases, with voting in Mirpur set for July 27 and elections in the protest-hit Poonch division postponed until August 10.

Voting in the regional capital, Muzaffarabad, has been delayed until August 2 over security concerns. The JAAC continues to stage a sit-in in Rawalakot, near the Line of Control with India.

A major question is whether the elections can restore public confidence or merely offer a temporary pause in public anger.

"We are just asking for fair representation, which is our right," Ali Raza, a 22-year-old student protester in Rawalakot, told DW. "The local people who live here should have the right to choose their representatives, not the refugees who settled here from India."

"The election is a major opportunity for the people of AJK to choose their representatives," said Shazia Marri, the central information...
body.zh: 在为印控克什米尔流离失所者保留席位而发生数周致命抗议后，巴控克什米尔即将举行投票。一个当地团体呼吁抵制选举。 巴控克什米尔的第一阶段地方选举定于 7 月 27 日星期一举行，最近被取缔的查谟克​​什米尔联合人民行动委员会 (JAAC)（一个民间社会团体的草根联盟）呼吁抵制。 JAAC一直要求废除地区议会中为印控克什米尔流离失所者和居住在巴基斯坦的人保留的12个席位。该组织认为，只有巴控克什米尔的居民才有资格参加地区选举。 巴控克什米尔最高法院裁定难民席位受宪法保护，未经宪法修正案不得废除，争端升级。 6月，地方政府以公共秩序威胁为由，根据反恐法取缔了JAAC，并拘留了数十名其支持者。 这项禁令出台之际，围绕难民席位的紧张局势不断加剧，且该组织废除难民席位的运动引发了暴力抗议。 据路透社援引当地估计，自 6 月以来，骚乱已造成约 30 人死亡。 印度和巴基斯坦都声称对整个克什米尔拥有主权，但两国仅控制着该地区的一部分，这使得这个穆斯林占多数的地区自 1947 年脱离英国独立以来一直成为这两个拥有核武器的邻国之间的冲突点。 自六月初以来，巴控克什米尔——当地称为自由查谟和克什米尔（AJK）——见证了持续数周的抗议和静坐。虽然难民席位争议已成为一个主要问题，但 JAAC 还致力于进行更广泛的经济和治理改革。 骚乱发生后，当局将投票分为三个阶段，米尔布尔的投票定于 7 月 27 日进行，而遭受抗议活动的庞奇区的选举则推迟至 8 月 10 日。 出于安全考虑，地区首府穆扎法拉巴德的投票已推迟至 8 月 2 日。 JAAC 继续在印度控制线附近的拉瓦拉科特举行静坐。 一个主要问题是，选举能否恢复公众信心，或者只是暂时平息公众的愤怒。 “我们只是要求公平的代表权，这是我们的权利，”拉瓦拉科特的 22 岁学生抗议者阿里·拉扎 (Ali Raza) 告诉德国之声。 “居住在这里的当地人应该有权选择他们的代表，而不是从印度定居在这里的难民。” 中央新闻社沙齐亚·马里（Shazia Marri）表示：“这次选举是 AJK 人民选择代表的重大机会。”

reflection.zh: 巴控克什米尔地区持续的紧张局势和抗议活动，凸显了社区之间可能出现的深刻分歧，尤其是在流离失所者的权利和代表权问题上。雅伟通过基督提供了一个愿景，即敌意的墙被拆毁，使两个群体合而为一。这提醒我们，真正的和平不仅来自政治进程，更来自一项神圣的工作，它能使疏远的内心和民族和解。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
title.zh: 苏丹内战：平民被用作‘人肉盾牌’

summary.en: The humanitarian situation in El Obeid, Sudan, is deteriorating, with reports of civilians being used as 'human shields' and children suffering trauma, unable to attend school. Rights organizations are warning of widespread atrocities.
summary.zh: 苏丹被围困城市埃尔奥贝德的人道主义局势日益恶化，人权组织警告可能发生大规模暴行。平民被用作‘人肉盾牌’，儿童遭受创伤，不敢上学。

body.en:
The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.

Flattened houses and rubble where a school once stood: These are the scenes that have appeared in footage of the Sudanese city of El Obeid published by Ayin Network, a nonpartisan Sudanese media outlet. Drone attacks by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have caused enormous damage to civilian infrastructure, including power grids, transformers, water treatment plants, schools, universities and hospitals in the capital of North Kordofan.

The local population is struggling to survive,  according to Ahmed Awad, project manager for the UK children's rights organization Plan International, and a native of El Obeid. The city — whose population previously numbered half a million but has now become home to several hundred thousand internally displaced persons (IDP) — is under siege, he added.

There is a shortage of medical supplies as well as food and safe, clean water, and Awad said he saw long queues of IDPs at just one water pump: "Sometimes you can spend all day to get one liter of water for two or three days."

He added that a drone had hit a primary school and killed three children, which had caused trauma among other children, many of whom no longer dared go to school.

"One of the mothers said three of her children cannot sleep because always they are in fear of something happening again," he said, adding that Plan International tried "to provide psychosocial support" for people scared of drones that could hit a classroom at any time.

El Obeid is a strategically important location. The city is a trading hub in the middle of the desert on the only major route between Sudan's capital, Khartoum — which is controlled by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) — and the western Darfur region, large parts of which are under the control of the RSF. Since the war began in 2023, the city has been captured by the RSF and recaptured by the army and allied militias many times.

El Obeid is currently controlled by the army, which has some 13,000 soldiers stationed there, and has been on the front line since fighting shifted from Darfur to Kordofan at the beginning of the year. The RSF has deployed troops to about 30 kilometers (18.6 miles) beyond the city limits, and has been using drones to bomb civilian infrastructure.

Analysts, aid organizations and the United Nations have warned that the RSF could soon capture El Obeid. They fear a similar scenario to that which unfolded in the city of El Fasher in the neighboring state of North Darfur in October 2025, when...
body.zh: 苏丹被围困城市埃尔奥贝德的局势日益恶化，人权组织警告可能发生大规模暴行。孩子们受到创伤，不敢上学。 曾经有一所学校矗立的房屋和瓦砾被夷为平地：这些场景出现在苏丹无党派媒体 Ayin Network 发布的苏丹城市埃尔奥贝德的镜头中。准军事快速支援部队（RSF）的无人机袭击对北科尔多凡州首府的民用基础设施造成了巨大破坏，包括电网、变压器、水处理厂、学校、大学和医院。 英国儿童权利组织国际计划的项目经理、土生土长的埃尔奥贝德艾哈迈德·阿瓦德表示，当地居民正在为生存而苦苦挣扎。他补充说，这座城市以前有 50 万人口，但现在已成为数十万国内流离失所者 (IDP) 的家园。 医疗用品、食品和安全清洁的水都短缺，阿瓦德说，他看到国内流离失所者在一个水泵前排起了长队：“有时你需要花一整天的时间才能获得两三天的一升水。” 他补充说，一架无人机袭击了一所小学，导致三名儿童死亡，这给其他儿童造成了创伤，其中许多人不再敢去上学。 “其中一位母亲说，她的三个孩子睡不着，因为他们总是担心再次发生什么事情，”他说，并补充说，国际计划试图为那些担心随时可能袭击教室的无人机的人们“提供社会心理支持”。 埃尔奥贝德是一个具有重要战略意义的地点。 这座城市是沙漠中部的一个贸易中心，位于苏丹首都喀土穆（由苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 控制）和西达尔富尔地区（其中大部分地区由无国界部队控制）之间的唯一主要路线上。自2023年战争爆发以来，这座城市多次被无国界医生组织占领，并多次被军队和盟军民兵收复。 埃尔奥贝德目前由军队控制，军队驻扎在那里约 13,000 名士兵，自从年初战事从达尔富尔转移到科尔多凡以来，奥贝德一直处于前线。无国界医生组织已将部队部署到城市边界外约 30 公里（18.6 英里）处，并一直在使用无人机轰炸民用基础设施。 分析人士、援助组织和联合国警告说，无国界医生组织可能很快就会抓获埃尔奥贝德。他们担心会出现与 2025 年 10 月邻近的北达尔富尔州法希尔市类似的情况，当时……

reflection.en: This tragic report from Sudan calls us to remember the vulnerable, especially children, who are caught in conflicts not of their making. Yahweh's word urges us to be a voice for the voiceless, advocating for the protection and dignity of those used as human shields and suffering atrocities. Even in despair, we are called to uphold justice and compassion for...
reflection.zh: 苏丹这则悲惨的报道提醒我们，要记念那些并非因自己过错而卷入冲突的弱势群体，特别是儿童。雅伟的话语敦促我们为那些不能为自己发声的人仗义执言，为那些被用作人肉盾牌、遭受暴行的人争取保护和尊严。即使在绝望中，我们仍蒙召为贫困和有需要的人维护公义和怜悯。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘I thought it didn’t stand a cat’s chance in hell’: Andrew Ridgeley on Wham’s surreal trip to China
title.zh: ‘我以为它根本没有一丝希望’：安德鲁·里奇利谈威猛乐队超现实的中国之旅

summary.en: Four decades after Wham! became the first Western pop act to tour China, Andrew Ridgeley reflected on the surreal experience, including silent gigs and awkward embassy receptions. He also recalled the “bloody ludicrous” hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director for the 1985 trip.
summary.zh: 威猛乐队成为首个在中国巡演的西方流行乐队四十年后，安德鲁·里奇利回顾了那次超现实的经历，包括沉默的演出和尴尬的使馆招待会。他还回忆起1985年那次旅行中“荒谬至极”地聘请林赛·安德森担任导演。

body.en: Four decades after he and George Michael became the first western pop act to tour the country, Ridgeley recalls silent gigs, awkward embassy receptions – and the ‘bloody ludicrous’ hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director There has always been something surreal about Wham!’s 1985 trip to China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley looked like alien visitors on the streets of Beijing, their bouffant hair and flamboyant outfits setting them apart from the Mao jackets and drab uniforms of the Chinese people they encountered. Now the full strangeness of the duo’s brief trip, which made them the first western pop act to play in the country, is explored in a fascinating documentary film, Wham! 10 Days in China. Using previously unseen archive footage and featuring new interviews with many of the people involved in the tour, it shows the extraordinary impact Wham!’s two concerts had on their Chinese audience, as well as providing a snapshot of a country on the brink of great change. Continue reading...
body.zh: 里奇利和乔治·迈克尔成为第一个在中国巡演的西方流行艺人四十年后，里奇利回忆起无声的演出、尴尬的大使馆招待会，以及聘请林赛·安德森担任导演的“极其荒唐”的事。威猛乐队 1985 年的中国之行总是给人一种超现实的感觉。乔治·迈克尔（George Michael）和安德鲁·里奇利（Andrew Ridgeley）在北京街头看起来就像外来的访客，他们蓬松的头发和华丽的服装使他们与他们遇到的中国人的毛泽东夹克和土褐色制服截然不同。现在，一部引人入胜的纪录片《威猛！》（Wham！中国10天。它使用了以前未公开的档案片段，并对参与巡演的许多人进行了新的采访，展示了威猛乐队的两场音乐会对中国观众的非凡影响，并提供了一个处于巨大变革边缘的国家的快照。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Wham!'s pioneering tour of China was a venture into uncharted cultural territory, marked by both novelty and unexpected challenges. When we commit our plans and endeavors to Yahweh, we acknowledge that even the most ambitious or unusual projects can find their purpose and direction. This reminds us that every step into the unknown, whether personal or...
reflection.zh: 威猛乐队对中国的开创性巡演是一次进入未知文化领域的尝试，充满了新奇和意想不到的挑战。当我们把自己的计划和努力交托给雅伟时，我们承认即使是最雄心勃勃或不寻常的项目也能找到其目的和方向。这提醒我们，无论是个人还是文化上，每一步迈向未知都可以信赖更高的智慧。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs hit sales
title.zh: Shein因特朗普关税影响销售额，亏损9900万美元

summary.en: Fast fashion giant Shein reported a $99 million loss as it prepares for its stock market debut in Hong Kong, with the company attributing the decline to Trump-era tariffs.
summary.zh: 快时尚巨头Shein公布亏损9900万美元，正值其准备在香港首次公开募股之际，该公司将亏损归因于特朗普时代的关税。

body.en:
Shein says it swung to a quarterly loss as its sales slowed after US President Donald Trump removed an import duty exemption on small packages.

It also comes as uncertainty remains over the tit-for-tat US-China tariffs wars, which is currently paused.

The fast-fashion giant, which has its headquarters in Singapore but was founded in China, said it lost $99m (£74.1m) in the first three months of the year, compared with a net income of $395m a year earlier.

The announcement is part of the firm's preparations ahead of its stock market debut in Hong Kong, although the filing did not give any details on the size, timetable or pricing of the planned initial public offering (IPO).

"In response to the increased duties and taxes, we are pursuing a wide range of options, including increasing our prices in the US market to offset a portion of the increased costs," Shein said in the filing.

The company also said the Iran war had hit demand, increased costs and caused delays of deliveries in some markets.

The first-quarter figures also partly reflected a paper loss of $328m due to an accounting change for special investor shares. The shares can be turned into ordinary stock later, and their value can change before a listing.

The filing showed that in the year to the end of March 2026 Shein had 281 million active customers - a rise of more than 16% on a year earlier - who placed a total of more than one billion orders.

On 10 July, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) gave Shein approval for a Hong Kong share sale after failed attempts to list in New York and London.

The figures show the impact of a Trump-signed executive order to end a global tariff exemption that had been used by US shoppers of low-cost goods.

That order, which came into effect on 29 August 2025, broadened an earlier presidential action which specifically targeted cheap products from China and Hong Kong to cover the rest of the world.

The so-called de minimis exemption had allowed goods valued at $800 or less to enter the US without paying any tariffs. US consumers relied on the exemption to buy cheap goods from online commerce sites like Shein and Temu.

The White House said the global exemption was being used to "evade tariffs and funnel deadly synthetic opioids" to the US.

"The removal of the US de minimis exemption has had an adverse impact on our sales in the US and the overall growth of our net revenues," Shein said in the filing.

Earlier in July, the European Union imposed a €3 (£2.56; $3.42) levy on low-value e-commerce imports.

The measure is aimed to curb what the trading bloc has said is unfair competition from China.
body.zh: Shein 表示，在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普取消小包装进口关税豁免后，其销售放缓，导致该公司出现季度亏损。 与此同时，中美针锋相对的关税战仍存在不确定性，目前该战已暂停。 这家总部位于新加坡但成立于中国的快时尚巨头表示，今年前三个月亏损 9900 万美元（7410 万英镑），而去年同期净利润为 3.95 亿美元。 该公告是该公司在香港股市首次亮相之前准备工作的一部分，尽管该文件没有提供有关计划首次公开募股（IPO）的规模、时间表或定价的任何细节。 谢因在文件中表示：“为了应对关税和税收的增加，我们正在寻求多种选择，包括提高我们在美国市场的价格，以抵消部分增加的成本。” 该公司还表示，伊朗战争打击了需求，增加了成本，并导致一些市场的交货延迟。 第一季度的数据还部分反映了由于特殊投资者股票的会计变更而导致的 3.28 亿美元的账面亏损。这些股票随后可以转换为普通股，并且其价值可以在上市前发生变化。 文件显示，截至 2026 年 3 月底的一年里，Shein 拥有 2.81 亿活跃客户，同比增长超过 16%，订单总数超过 10 亿。 7 月 10 日，中国证监会 (CSRC) 批准 Shein 在纽约和伦敦上市失败后在香港发售股票。 这些数据显示了特朗普签署的一项终止美国消费者购买低成本商品的全球关税豁免的行政命令的影响。 该命令于 2025 年 8 月 29 日生效，扩大了之前的总统行动范围，该行动专门针对来自中国和香港的廉价产品，涵盖世界其他地区。 所谓的最低限度豁免允许价值 800 美元或以下的商品进入美国而无需支付任何关税。美国消费者依靠豁免从 Shein 和 Temu 等电子商务网站购买廉价商品。 白宫表示，全球豁免被用来“逃避关税并将致命的合成阿片类药物输送到美国”。 谢因在文件中表示：“取消美国最低限度豁免对我们在美国的销售和净收入的整体增长产生了不利影响。” 7 月初，欧盟对低价值电子商务进口商品征收 3 欧元（2.56 英镑；3.42 美元）的关税。 该措施旨在遏制贸易集团所说的来自中国的不公平竞争。

reflection.en: The news of a significant financial loss for a major company reminds us that human endeavors, even those meticulously planned, are subject to forces beyond our control. Psalm 75:7 reminds us that Yahweh alone is the judge, bringing one down and lifting another up, inviting us to trust in His ultimate sovereignty over all outcomes.
reflection.zh: 一家大型公司蒙受巨额财务损失的消息提醒我们，人类的努力，即使是精心策划的，也受制于我们无法控制的力量。诗篇75:7提醒我们，唯有雅伟是审判者，他使这人降卑，使那人升高，邀请我们信靠他掌管一切结果的最终主权。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Watch: Scaffolding tumbles from Hong Kong building as Typhoon Noul makes landfall
title.zh: 观看：台风“诺尔”登陆香港，脚手架从大楼坠落

summary.en: Typhoon Noul, described by state media as the strongest to hit China this year, caused scaffolding to collapse from a building in Hong Kong as it made landfall.
summary.zh: 据官方媒体报道，台风“诺尔”是今年迄今为止登陆中国的最强台风，在香港登陆时导致一栋建筑的脚手架倒塌。

body.en:
Police said they received numerous calls after multi-storey scaffolding along Cheung Sha Wan Road collapsed in powerful winds on Saturday. No injuries have been reported.

Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China on Sunday morning, lashing the region with strong winds and heavy rain and forcing Hong Kong airport to cancel around 360 passenger flights.

The typhoon is the strongest to make landfall in China in 2026 to date, according to state media.
body.zh: 警方表示，周六长沙湾道多层脚手架在强风中倒塌后，他们接到大量报警电话。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。 台风诺尔周日早上在中国南部登陆，给该地区带来强风和大雨，迫使香港机场取消约360个客运航班。 据官方媒体报道，这场台风是迄今为止在 2026 年登陆中国的最强台风。

reflection.en: The destructive power of a typhoon reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the forces that cause it to groan. In such moments, we are reminded of the wider suffering in the world, and our longing for restoration.
reflection.zh: 台风的破坏力提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，并且有使其呻吟的力量。在这样的时刻，我们被提醒世上更广泛的苦难，以及我们对复兴的渴望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Berlin Pride: Latest in string of deadly vehicle attacks
title.zh: 柏林骄傲：最新一连串致命车辆袭击事件

summary.en: The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.

A Christopher Street Day event in the German capital, which attracts thousands of people every year, was attacked on Saturday night by a 21-year-old suspect who police said was associated with the "Islamist scene" in Berlin. One person was killed and another 16 people were injured, while the suspect, named as Abdul B., fled the scene.

Two people were killed and 20 more injured in early May when a car drove through a crowd in the eastern German city of Leipzig. The suspect in the case was described as a 33-year-old German national and local resident, who had been known to police, though not for relevant offenses.

At least two people were killed and several were injured in the southwestern German city of Mannheim in 2025 when a motorist intentionally drove his car into a crowd of people , according to police and public prosecutors. Authorities identified the suspect as a 40-year-old German man. Law enforcement ruled out a political motive at the time, though the man had paid a fine under Germany's hate crime laws for a comment he made on a social media platform in 2018.

A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old daughter were killed in Munich in February last year when a car was rammed into a demonstration organized by the trade union Verdi. A 25-year-old Afghan man subsequently went on trial for their murder, as well as the attempted murder of the dozens of other people injured in the attack. 

A vehicle plowed into a crowd of New Orleans revelers early on New Year's Day 2025, killing 14 people and injuring dozens of others. The driver of the vehicle and two police officers were killed in a firefight soon after the attack, which took place at about 3:15 in the morning local time. The FBI said it was investigating the incident as an act of terrorism.

At least six people died and more than 300 were injured when a man slammed a rented BMW SUV into a Christmas market in eastern Germany. The suspect, who was arrested at the scene, was a 50-year-old doctor originally from Saudi Arabia who had expressed anti-Muslim views and support for the far-right AfD party. In June 2026, he was sentenced to life in prison, with the court noting the severity of his crime, which more or less rules out the possibility of an early release.

body.zh: 柏林骄傲活动中的袭击只是一长串将车辆用作武器的事件中的最新一起。近年来，美国、加拿大和中国也发生过类似的攻击。 德国首都的克里斯托弗街日活动每年都会吸引数千人参加，周六晚上，该活动遭到一名 21 岁嫌疑人的袭击，警方称该嫌疑人与柏林的“伊斯兰主义现场”有关。造成 1 人死亡、16 人受伤，嫌疑人 Abdul B. 逃离现场。 5 月初，德国东部城市莱比锡一辆汽车驶过人群，造成两人死亡、二十多人受伤。据描述，该案嫌疑人是一名 33 岁的德国国民和当地居民，警方认识他，但并未因相关罪行而认识他。 据警方和检察官称，2025 年，德国西南部城市曼海姆一名驾车者故意驾车冲撞人群，造成至少两人死亡、多人受伤。 当局确认嫌疑人是一名 40 岁的德国男子。执法部门当时排除了政治动机，尽管该男子因 2018 年在社交媒体平台上发表的评论而根据德国仇恨犯罪法缴纳了罚款。 去年2月，慕尼黑工会威尔第组织的一场示威活动中，一辆汽车被撞，导致一名37岁的妇女和她两岁的女儿丧生。一名 25 岁的阿富汗男子随后因谋杀以及企图谋杀袭击中受伤的其他数十人而接受审判。 2025 年元旦早些时候，一辆汽车冲撞了新奥尔良狂欢者的人群，造成 14 人死亡、数十人受伤。袭击发生在当地时间凌晨 3 点 15 分左右，车辆司机和两名警察在袭击发生后不久的交火中丧生。 联邦调查局表示，正在将此事件作为恐怖主义行为进行调查。 一名男子将一辆租来的宝马 SUV 撞向德国东部的圣诞市场，造成至少 6 人死亡、300 多人受伤。现场被捕的嫌疑人是一名来自沙特阿拉伯的 50 岁医生，曾表达反穆斯林观点并支持极右翼选择党。 2026 年 6 月，他被判处终身监禁，法院注意到他罪行的严重性，这或多或少排除了提前释放的可能性。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，一名 62 岁的司机驾驶一辆小型 SUV 撞向在中国南方一个体育场馆锻炼的人们，造成 38 人死亡，这是该国多年来最致命的大规模凶杀案。另有 48 人受伤。当局表示，肇事者情绪激动……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: From the strait of Hormuz to the North Sea, a global maritime war rages around us – and more than the price of oil is at stake | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 从霍尔木兹海峡到北海，一场全球海上战争在我们身边肆虐——不仅仅是石油价格受到威胁

summary.en: A recent report highlights the breakdown of international maritime cooperation, warning of a global maritime conflict extending from the Strait of Hormuz to the North Sea. The article notes that the US military is actively protecting merchant shipping from Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, indicating a wider...
summary.zh: 一份最新报告指出，国际海上合作正在瓦解，并警告一场全球海上冲突正从霍尔木兹海峡蔓延至北海。文章提到，美国军方正在霍尔木兹海峡积极保护商船免受伊朗袭击，这表明基于规则的秩序正在更广泛地崩溃。

body.en: The collapse of the rules-based order is not confined to the land: we’re imperilled as centuries of maritime cooperation sink beneath the waves The US military campaign to protect merchant shipping from Iranian attacks by asserting direct maritime control in the strait of Hormuz is not an idea unique to Donald Trump’s administration. Almost exactly 200 years ago, in the period 1825-27, a powerful US naval squadron led by Commodore John Rodgers was sent to the Mediterranean to defend American ships from the depredations of Greek corsairs and pirates. For all the new-minted republic’s brave talk of liberty, the US squadron did not assist Greece’s ongoing “regime change” struggle for independence from the Ottoman empire. Its sole, self-serving purpose was to defend US trade, markets and business interests. After abandoning his call for a people’s revolution in Tehran , this, too, is what Trump’s reckless war with Iran has now boiled down to. Simon Tisdall is a Guardian foreign affairs commentator Continue reading...
body.zh: 基于规则的秩序的崩溃不仅限于陆地：随着几个世纪的海上​​合作沉入海浪之下，我们面临危险美国通过对霍尔木兹海峡实施直接海上控制来保护商船免受伊朗袭击的军事行动并不是唐纳德·特朗普政府独有的想法。几乎整整 200 年前，即 1825-27 年期间，由准将约翰·罗杰斯 (John Rodgers) 率领的一支强大的美国海军中队被派往地中海，保护美国船只免受希腊海盗和海盗的掠夺。尽管这个新成立的共和国勇敢地谈论自由，但美国中队并没有协助希腊正在进行的争取从奥斯曼帝国独立的“政权更迭”斗争。其唯一的、自私的目的是捍卫美国的贸易、市场和商业利益。在放弃了德黑兰人民革命的呼吁之后，特朗普与伊朗的鲁莽战争也归结为这一点。西蒙·蒂斯达尔是卫报外交事务评论员继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a global maritime war and the collapse of international order can feel overwhelming, suggesting a world where conflict is becoming the norm. Yet, Psalm 46:9 reminds us that Yahweh ultimately has the power to make wars cease, breaking weapons and bringing an end to conflict. This offers a profound hope that even in the face of widespread tension,...
reflection.zh: 全球海上战争和国际秩序崩溃的消息可能令人感到不知所措，似乎冲突正成为常态。然而，诗篇46:9提醒我们，雅伟最终有能力止息战争，折断弓、折断枪，使冲突终结。这在面对普遍紧张局势时，提供了一个深刻的希望，即通过神圣的干预，更大的和平是可能实现的。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea, 17 missing
title.zh: 越南船只在南海沉没，17人失踪

summary.en: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.
summary.zh: 一艘载有62名船员的越南籍货船在南海永暑礁附近沉没，导致17人失踪。南海是世界上最重要且争议不断的海域之一。

body.en:
A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.

Rescuers were searching on Sunday for 17 people missing after a Vietnamese ship sank in the South China Sea , China's ⁠state media reported.

Authorities in the Chinese island province of Hainan said the cargo vessel Khoi ​Nguyen 18 ran into trouble near Yongshu Reef, also known as Fiery Cross Reef, state broadcaster CCTV said.

The ship was carrying 62 crew members, and 45 people were rescued from the water.

Vietnamese authorities arrived at the scene immediately after the cargo ship "sank while operating in bad weather conditions in the East Sea," Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said in a statement to AFP news agency.

A Chinese rescue ship, the Nanhai Jiu 115, first spotted what was believed to be a distress flare from the vessel shortly before 6:30 pm on Saturday (1030 GMT).

The Khoi Nguyen 18 is a Vietnamese-registered ship measuring just under 70 meters (230 feet) in length, according to state news agency Xinhua.

It added that six Chinese vessels, a rescue helicopter and a Vietnamese vessel were involved in the search-and-rescue operations.

Hang said that authorities and fishing vessels were "actively searching for the remaining people."

Beijing claims sovereignty over almost the entire South China Sea, despite the 2016 international ruling, initiated by the Philippines against China, that its assertion has no legal basis.

One of the most highly contested areas is the ​ Spratly Islands , which China calls the Nansha Islands, where China has built runways ⁠and militarized artificial islands.

But ​Beijing's sweeping claims to the busy waterway overlap with those of other countries, including Vietnam, the Philippines, Brunei, Malaysia and Taiwan .

reflection.en: The news of a sunken vessel and missing crew members brings profound sorrow, reminding us of the fragility of life and the pain of loss. In moments of such tragedy, we hold onto the promise that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more death or suffering.
reflection.zh: 船只沉没和船员失踪的消息带来深切的悲痛，提醒我们生命的脆弱和失去的痛苦。在这样的悲剧中，我们紧紧抓住雅伟的应许，有一天他将擦去所有的眼泪，不再有死亡和痛苦。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.

title.en: Typhoon Noul forces more than 715,000 from homes and cancels hundreds of flights in China and Hong Kong
title.zh: 台风“诺尔”迫使逾71.5万人撤离家园，中港数百航班取消

summary.en: Typhoon Noul, the strongest to hit China this year, made landfall over the weekend, bringing severe winds and heavy rain to southern China and Hong Kong. The storm forced over 715,000 people from their homes and led to hundreds of flight cancellations.
summary.zh: 今年迄今为止登陆中国的最强台风“诺尔”于周末登陆，给华南地区和香港带来了强风暴雨。这场风暴导致超过71.5万人被迫撤离家园，数百趟航班被取消。

body.en:
Typhoon Noul made landfall early Sunday bringing strong winds and heavy rain to southern China, including Hong Kong , over the weekend.

It prompted the evacuation of hundreds of thousands of people in Guangdong province with the region on high alert and hundreds of flights cancelled.

The typhoon – the strongest to make landfall in China so far this year – will dump heavy to torrential rains across much of southern China for two days, authorities said, after ⁠sweeping the province of ⁠Guangdong ​and neighbouring Hong Kong with gale-force winds.

The ⁠year’s 12th tropical cyclone and China’s third this month, Noul, which ​means the glow of sunrise ‌or sunset in Korean, struck ‌the coast of Huidong county about 3:50 am, officials ‌said.

It is expected to bring strong winds and heavy rain to nearby provinces such as Jiangxi and Hunan as it moves inland, state media said, with the rains likely to persist until Tuesday.

Extremely heavy to exceptional downpours are expected to lash some areas including the ‌province of Fujian, as the National Meteorological Centre forecast heavy to torrential rain from Sunday until Monday morning across ​much of China’s south.

Authorities urged local governments to pay special attention to flood-prone areas such as zones of mountains and rivers, building sites, valleys and bridges.

Hong Kong’s Observatory said Noul, with maximum sustained winds of 110 km/h (68 mph) near its centre, was moving Sunday into inland Guangdong and weakening progressively.

More than 715,000 people had been relocated for safety in Guangdong province, according to state media. Train services in the province were cancelled for Sunday, according to China News Service.

China’s National Meteorological Center expected parts of southern Guangdong and south-eastern Fujian provinces to experience heavy rain and strong winds. Many trees were seen uprooted in Huilai county, located on the coast of Guangdong province, state broadcaster CCTV reported.

Hong Kong’s airport authority said about 350 flights were cancelled Sunday. At least nine people were injured across the city during the typhoon period, according to authorities. Officials said flights will gradually begin resuming on Sunday afternoon.

As Noul approached Hong Kong, parts of a large scaffolding on a high-rise building collapsed on Saturday, police said, although initial reports indicated there were no injuries.

Taiwan’s Central Weather Administration said Noul was bringing rainfall to parts of southern and eastern Taiwan. It was passing over waters south of Taiwan, and was moving away from the island on Saturday.
